title: Add certificate-expiry monitoring for mail relays
summary: 30-day-ahead expiry alerts for all relay TLS certificates. Raised as corrective action from TCK-1001.

title: Fix cache-invalidation webhook in portal v2.4.2
summary: Deploy portal v2.4.2 restoring webhook delivery broken in v2.4.1.

title: Dead-letter alerting + release smoke test for webhooks
summary: Alert on dead-lettered webhook events; add webhook delivery check to the release checklist. Corrective action from TCK-1004.

title: Label printer firmware 4.2 fleet upgrade

title: Enable TLS on site-B telemetry feed
summary: Migrate telemetry feed from plain TCP to TLS 1.3 per security baseline.

title: TransBaltic EDI feed go-live
summary: Enable production ingestion of TransBaltic DESADV/IFTSTA after passed UAT.

title: Mandatory MFA for Northwind admin accounts
summary: TOTP MFA enrolment for 12 admin accounts, staged over two days.
